messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/stream (us-west-2 gateway). 5xx spike >15% over the last 3m. Paging oncall: @alex. Incident ID INC-2145. https://monitoring.redwood/INC-2145

alex: ACK — I'm oncall. any recent deploys or config changes?

incidents-bot: Recent deploy detected: runtime/gateway v3.14 rolled 10m ago by @shiv. Confidence: medium.

maya: Pulling traces now. Gateway logs show a ton of 'client cancelled' and 'unexpected EOF while reading chunked body' errors. Patterns cluster around stream start and at ~600 tokens.

ian: Looking at runner logs — upstreams are returning 502 with body close shortly after first chunks. Not consistent across hosts. Could be chunked trailer corruption or early EOF from worker.

shiv: I shipped a small change to the chunked encoder buffer in v3.14 (reduce internal buffer flush). Rolling back as precaution. @deploy-bot rollback runtime/gateway v3.13

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: runtime/gateway -> v3.13. Rolling back in us-west-2. ETA ~90s.

alex: Live mitigation idea: switch high-error tenants from streaming to paged (non-stream) endpoint as a temporary fallback. That reduces client-visible partials. Can we toggle routing quickly?

ian: Patching routing rule now. We'll add header-based routing: if X-Stream-Errors > 5 then send to /v1/paged. Applying to tenant groups with >5% failure.

shiv: Rollback finished on us-west-2, servers now at v3.13. Observability shows immediate effect in some nodes.

maya: Metrics update — error rate fell from 18% -> 6% within 60s post-rollback + routing change. Client cancel logs still present but reduced.

liz: Product update: two enterprise customers opened tickets describing mid-stream aborts and missing tokens. Marking P2, Customer Success engaged.

alex: Can someone capture a failed session trace and gateway chunk frames? Need a raw example for repro. @ian can you grab gw-3?

ian: Capturing pcap + gateway debug logs from gw-3 now. Uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-2145/gw-3/ (access: restricted). Also saved a sample request id: req_usw2_7f9c2a.

maya: Snippet from gateway logs: 
```
2025-06-12T21:14:02Z gw-3 runtime ERROR chunked body: invalid chunk-size at pos 0, closing connection
2025-06-12T21:14:02Z gw-3 runtime WARN upstream-close: unexpected EOF while reading chunked body
2025-06-12T21:14:02Z gw-3 runtime INFO client-cancel: client closed connection after 612 tokens
```
This repeats across nodes but with slightly different stack traces.

shiv: I reproduced locally: start a long stream, and force client cancel around token 600 — gateway sometimes writes an invalid chunk header when worker responds around the same time. Looks like a race between flush and trailer write.

alex: Customer impact summary: 3 enterprise accounts affected, ~1.2k sessions (~12% of streaming sessions in us-west-2) experienced aborted streams or partial outputs. No data leak, but degraded UX.

maya: Immediate next steps: 1) keep rollback v3.13 in place for 2h, 2) add a gateway guard to detect invalid chunk-size and return 503 early (graceful fail), 3) enable additional chunk-boundary tracing, 4) schedule postmortem.

ian: Applied a temporary gateway config patch: increased keepalive to 120s and enabled per-connection backpressure. Command used: ```kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n runtime -p '{"data":{"keepalive":"120s","chunked_strict":"false"}}'```

deploy-bot: Configmap patched in us-west-2 clusters.

maya: Monitoring (5m): error rate stabilized ~5.8%. Latency slightly improved. Setting new alert threshold to 8% to catch regression.

alex: Oncall plan: I'll stay for initial mitigation and monitor for 2 hours. If error rate creeps back up above 8%, page SRE lead @maya and escalate to Eng. Otherwise, handoff to next oncall in 2 hours — tag will be updated in PD with INC-2145-assigned-alex.

shiv: I'll open a PR to add stricter chunk flush ordering and extra unit tests for concurrent client-cancel scenarios. Target: hotfix branch, then patch release.

liz: Notifying impacted customers and creating incident summary for CS. Will attach logs and what changed.

alex: Closing live triage for now. We'll create a postmortem doc, owners: maya (SRE root cause), shiv (runtime fix), ian (repro + traces), liz (customer comms). Thanks all. :heart: :thumbsup:

shiv: :thumbsup: I owe you all coffee.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2145 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Follow-ups assigned. Postmortem required.
